modelReview.interpretation: Stage 3C cleared its pre-locked research gates, but these limitations must remain visible during Stage 4 shadow testing and cannot be treated as production approval.

starterAuthority.stage4Requirement: Bind each shadow matchup to a governed starter identity and embedded baseline quarterback value before calculating any differential.
starterAuthority.caseStudyRule: Named case studies may be reviewed as candidate records, but Stage 3D cannot assert a live starter map or retire uncertainty overlays.

flagDefinitions.MOVE_CAP_REACHED: The Stage 3C candidate reached the locked absolute movement cap and must receive focused Stage 4 sensitivity testing.
flagDefinitions.LARGE_MOVE: The candidate moved at least 0.50 points from the frozen EA prior.
flagDefinitions.ELITE_PRIOR_DOWNGRADE: A quarterback with a prior of at least 9.00 moved down by at least 0.50 points.
flagDefinitions.LOWER_PRIOR_UPGRADE: A quarterback with a prior no higher than 7.50 moved up by at least 0.50 points.
flagDefinitions.HIGH_CONFIDENCE_LARGE_MOVE: A high-confidence candidate also moved at least 0.50 points.
flagDefinitions.TOP67_LOW_SAMPLE_BLOCK: A member of the frozen 67-quarterback distribution cohort retained the prior because the performance sample was insufficient.
flagDefinitions.PERFORMANCE_PRIOR_DIVERGENCE: The performance-implied value differs from the Stage 2 prior by at least 1.00 point before shrinkage and the movement cap.
flagDefinitions.RANK_SHIFT: The deterministic ordinal position changed by at least the locked threshold; ties use player name and ID only for reproducibility.
flagDefinitions.CANDIDATE_AT_SCALE_BOUND: The candidate sits at the governed 6.00 or 9.50 scale boundary.
